summary: Added DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py) for Databricks connections using a client ID (login) and client secret (password). It generates auth_type: oauth with the secret passed as an env var, is exported from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/__init__.py, and is listed before DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in the claim order. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py. Tests were not run, per the instructions. Nothing was committed. Known tradeoff: a token connection that also sets a non-empty login would be claimed as OAuth. Docs and changelog were not updated.
